title: The Constitutional Court and Fundamental Rights Jurisprudence
grammar: Deontic future passive adjectives: -andó and -endő ('must be done / to be done')
goal: I can discuss the jurisdiction, powers, and historical role of the Hungarian Constitutional Court.
I can understand and form deontic verbal adjectives with -andó/-endő in judicial and normative texts.
I can analyze concepts of fundamental rights, judicial review, and annulment of unconstitutional laws.
